snippet.title: Shape Shooter 2000 (WIP) - Atari Jaguar Homebrew
snippet.description:
Enter The Zone and do battle face-to-face with that many-faced menace, The Shapes! Shapes bad! Make shapes go boom! It was originally part of JagJam 2024.

WARNING: It will NOT run on Virtual Jaguar, be it on RetroArch or BizHawk. It does run on BigPEmu, though.

Developed by sjc
Download the WIP build here: https://21twice.itch.io/ss2k
Nominated for "Atari Jaguar: Best WIP Homebrew" at the 7th Annual Atari Homebrew Awards over at AtariAge
